findings.summary: The change adds a Today ordering rule (high-priority suggestions first) only on the goal entity and form field; the Today screen and suggestion-ordering spec are not updated, so they may conflict with any existing ordering rule there.
findings.evidence: "Suggestions for high-priority goals are listed first on Today" / "high-priority suggestions come first on Today" — no corresponding change to the Today screen or its suggestion list

findings.summary: The new priority field is required on the entity but has no default there, while the form component says the default is normal, so existing goals and non-form creation paths have no defined value.
findings.evidence: - { name: priority, type: "enum high|normal" } (not optional, no default) vs "priority high or normal, default normal"

findings.summary: The schedule-correctness criterion now requires fixtures for priority changes, but priority is described only as affecting display order on Today, not schedule computation, so the criterion's scope does not match.
findings.evidence: "Fixed-clock fixtures cover zero logs, qualification, interval, depth and priority changes..."
